title: Raspberry Streusel Bars
changes_from_base: A buttery shortbread base with raspberry jam and fresh berries under an oat and pecan streusel, instead of caramel and chocolate.
summary: Shortbread bars with raspberry jam and fresh raspberries under an oat-pecan streusel.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, cut into pieces, cool room temperature
ingredients.note: 225 g for the base, 30 g for the streusel

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and line the large tin. Beat the flour, sugar and salt with 225 g butter, a piece at a time, until like damp sand. Take out about 300 g for the streusel.

steps.title: Prebake
steps.text: Press the remaining mixture firmly into the tin and bake 14-18 min, until golden at the edges.

steps.title: Streusel
steps.text: Mix the oats, pecans and brown sugar into the reserved crumbs, then rub in the last 30 g butter until small clumps form.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Mash the jam, raspberries and lemon juice together with a fork, leaving some berry pieces.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread the filling over the hot base, scatter the streusel over and bake 22-25 min, until bubbling and deep golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely, about 2 h, then cut into 24.

tips: Leave some raspberries in pieces for texture.
Spread the filling while the base is hot.
Freeze uncut bars for up to a month.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
